messages.subject: Multilevel SEM with Two Clusters
parts:
I am trying to run a multilevel SEM (example, abbreviated model specification below). Is it possible to run this with two clusters? Right now I am specifying one cluster "id" but I'd like to also specify "target". Essentially, I am trying to specify the regressions like the following mixed effects model: lmer(sd ~ d1 + d2 + d3 + d4 + d5 + d6 + d7 + (1|id) + (1|target), data = dat)

model <- '
      level: 1
          sd ~ d1 + d2 + d3+ d4 + d5 + d6 + d7
          st ~ d1 + d2 + d3+ d4 + d5 + d6 + d7
      level: 2
          sd ~ d1 + d2 + d3+ d4 + d5 + d6 + d7
          st ~ d1 + d2 + d3+ d4 + d5 + d6 + d7 '

fit <- sem(model, data = dat, cluster = "id")
